reviews.author: Irwin Lewis
reviews.text: Frank and his team are the best painters I have every used. They did a perfect job painting the outside and inside of my house. The exterior of this three storey house was challenging and they were up to the task. They also rebuilt some rotted window frames which saved me thousands of dollars. In addition, they are completely trustworthy, friendly, thoughtful and go the extra mile. Frank uses high quality paint and does it right the first time. He is a perfectionist and is not happy until he gets it right. My wife and I are so happy with the results. Win

reviews.author: Kendall Dragseth
reviews.text: Frank did some light painting in my apartment. Was very professional and cost effective. I would recommend him to anyone and will be using him again

reviews.author: Bryson Coons
reviews.text: The folks at this company are incredibly talented and knowledgeable about their craft. Had a couple rooms inside my house painted and never got a single drop anywhere it wasn't supposed to be. Cut every line precisely. 100% recommend hiring these people to do any painting/powerwashing jobs if you want it done well and on time.

reviews.author: James Richards
reviews.text: Frank and his team care. Finding a good contractor is hard. Finding a good contractor that is passionate about their work is even harder. These folks are some of the best contractors I've ever hired. I can't recommend them enough!

reviews.author: Rebecca Morrison
reviews.text: Mr.Griffin is the best, he was on time! When we had an issue with the paint color he immediately agreed and proceeded to change the color and fix the issue no extra cost. The best part no mess! He will be doing other work for me!

reviews.author: Jon Zuck
reviews.text: Eco-Painting and Contracting did a fantastic job on painting my living room. They even sanded and stain my fireplace mantle so it looks like new. Strongly recommend!

reviews.author: Kolton Lindell
reviews.text: Stellar company and extremely professional. They followed my requests down to specifics and are incredibly detail oriented. Will absolutely be contacting them again for my next project.
